TextBlock.Text: Escort two sealift ships through the corridor and stop the Russian strike aircraft.
Two Su-24M pairs approach the sealift corridor on separate routes. MiG-23MLD fighters cover the strike, supported by a Tu-142 patrol aircraft.
WIDOW 1: two YF-23 fighters. Algol and Antares travel in line astern. Yorktown provides close defense; an E-2C watches the approaches.

Intercept aircraft threatening the convoy. Keep the fighter screen ahead of the ships and the Hawkeye behind it. Both sealift ships must reach CONVOY after at least 25 minutes. Each Su-24M must be destroyed or reach EGRESS.

Win when the convoy and strike conditions are met and incoming weapons are clear. Losing either sealift ship, both fighters or neutral shipping fails the mission. Preserving Yorktown and the Hawkeye earns a bonus.

Your assigned aircraft start airborne with finite fuel and loaded weapons. Fighter sections start line abreast, one nautical mile apart; strike pairs use Vic. Give orders to the leader to control the section. Detach a wingman before assigning a separate task.

September 2025. A fictional Russian expeditionary force threatens shipping in the Gulf of Aden. The four missions are standalone scenarios. Older ships and aircraft remain in service in this alternate history. Requires only Sea Power and this mod.
